summary: FPU helper handling NaN/Inf inputs and normal-number rounding, called across timer, suspension, tire and memory paths. Saves the FPU control word via ReturnFPUControlWord(dword_5E65A0, 0xFFFF). When the exponent bits of the double input ((HIWORD(a1) & 0x7FF0)) equal 0x7FF0 the value is NaN/Inf: it is classified by UtilityFunction_1d2e, and depending on the class the function either restores the control word and returns the input unchanged (class <= 2), dispatches a math error through MathDispatchWithErrorFallback (class == 3), or falls through to ConditionalMathWithDAT005e9ad0Flag. For normal numbers it applies FrndMSVCCRTRounding for rounding. The double result is returned through the FPU stack register.

operations.description: Save the FPU control word into v2 via ReturnFPUControlWord(dword_5E65A0, 0xFFFF); the global dword_5E65A0 supplies the current control-word context.
Test the double exponent field: (HIWORD(a1) & 0x7FF0) == 0x7FF0 selects the NaN/Inf path, otherwise the normal-number rounding path is taken.
Classify the NaN/Inf payload: v3 = UtilityFunction_1d2e(LODWORD(a1), HIDWORD(a1)).
When the classification v3 > 0 and v3 <= 2, restore the FPU control word and return a1 unchanged (benign NaN/Inf kept as-is).
When the classification v3 == 3, dispatch the math error: MathDispatchWithErrorFallback(11, a1, v2), then return a1.

For other positive classifications (and for non-positive ones), route through ConditionalMathWithDAT005e9ad0Flag with dispatch code 8 and error code 11, passing both dword halves of a1 and of (a1 + 1.0), plus the saved control word v2.
Normal-number path: apply FrndMSVCCRTRounding(a1) to round the value.
Restore the FPU control word from v2 via ReturnFPUControlWord(v2, 0xFFFF) after rounding.
Return the double result (a1 for the NaN/Inf path, the rounded value on the normal-number path) through the FPU stack register.
